name: io.github.aurelio-nakamura/dataloupe
title: Dataloupe
description: Offline MCP server to explore CSV/JSON/Parquet/Excel: preview, query, diff, render interactive HTML

runtimeArguments.name: -i
runtimeArguments.description: Keep stdin open for the JSON-RPC stdio transport

runtimeArguments.name: --rm
runtimeArguments.description: Remove the container when the server exits

runtimeArguments.name: --mount
runtimeArguments.description: Mount the directory holding your data files into the container at /data (the server's file access is confined here)

source_path.description: Absolute path on the host to the directory containing your data files

environmentVariables.name: DATALOUPE_MCP_ROOT
environmentVariables.description: Directory the server is allowed to read data files from (inside the container). Defaults to /data.
